# WEAF AI: Addy Khan, AI automation consultant in Melbourne

> WEAF AI is the AI automation consultancy of Adnan "Addy" Khan, based in Point Cook, Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. Addy helps small and medium businesses hand repetitive work to AI. His lead service is AI voice agents (AI receptionists that answer calls 24/7, qualify callers, book appointments and follow up missed calls), which he has already set up for businesses in Sydney. He also builds lead follow-up, admin automation and outbound sales systems for B2B teams. Engagements start with a 60-minute online AI strategy session for $50 (AUD), credited toward any build, followed by a written plan within 48 hours.

## Key facts

- Who: Adnan (Addy) Khan, AI automation consultant and founder of WEAF AI
- Where: Point Cook, Melbourne, VIC 3030, Australia. Serves Melbourne (including Werribee, Williams Landing, Hoppers Crossing, Altona, Footscray and the CBD) and all of Australia online
- Entry offer: AI Automation Strategy Session, 60 minutes, online, $50, fee credited toward any build
- Booking: https://cal.com/adnan-khan-007/60min
- Lead service: AI voice agents / AI receptionist / AI phone answering for small businesses, already deployed for businesses in Sydney
- Other services after the session: lead follow-up and booking automation (for example missed-call text-back), admin automation (CRM entry, drafted replies, quotes, invoices, meeting notes), and B2B outbound (target lists, sequences, booked meetings). Builds are quoted at a fixed price
- Background: Computer Science degree (BITS Pilani, Dubai); founded WEAF TECH in Dubai in 2022; field sales in Sydney with an individual sales record above A$100K; Master of Management (Macquarie Business School); enterprise software sales across Australia and New Zealand since 2025; mentor in the Macquarie University Mentor Program
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/adnan-arif-khan-104354175/
- Newsletter: The WEAF Letter, one AI automation idea every fortnight (sign up at https://weaf.ai/)
- Contact: hello@weaf.ai
- ABN: 55 386 617 220
